everfall.config.title: Everfall Settings
yacl3.config.everfall:client_config.enab: Enables or disables Everfall's GUI particle effects.
yacl3.config.everfall:client_config.show: Show on screens over a world
Show particles on GUI screens while a world is open, such as inventory screens.
yacl3.config.everfall:client_config.prof: Selects the particle textures, animation, sounds, and recommended physics settings.
yacl3.config.everfall:client_config.dens: Multiplier for the rate at which new particles spawn. Higher values fill the screen faster.
yacl3.config.everfall:client_config.maxP: Maximum number of airborne and settled particles maintained at once.
yacl3.config.everfall:client_config.wind: Horizontal wind speed in display pixels per second. The sign sets the direction; stronger wind shifts more spawns from the top to the upwind side.
yacl3.config.everfall:client_config.grav: Downward acceleration in display pixels per second squared. Set to zero for no gravitational acceleration.
